packageRules.description: The Fluxer client packages are released together
Node types follow the oldest supported Node (engines >=24.15)
Stay on the Node 26 LTS build image; the distroless runtime names its major in the repo, so majors move by hand. A regex, because "<27" would reject every "-trixie-slim" tag as a semver prerelease.
